QuestInfo.name: [Stellar Detectives] A Conspiracy, Continued
QuestInfo.0: Examine the next entry in the Old Diary via the Quest Icon! What will become of the Stellar Detectives? Find out how the story ends!
QuestInfo.1: Examine the next entry in the Old Diary via the Quest Icon! What will become of the Stellar Detectives? Find out how the story ends!
QuestInfo.2: The Stellar Detectives fell prey to PULSAR's sinister trap. Scattered across Maple World, and with their memory stolen, only a nearly-blank diary holds the truth behind their forgotten adventure. The diary's message is clear. Return to PULSAR's spaceship, and finish the job!
